title: Albumblätter - No. 20
notable_excerpt: Key: D major. Chord journey: I - I6 - vi7 - i6/4 - V6 - V - I, IV6/5 - I4/2 - IV7 - I64 minor-inflected detour that returns to tonic. Texture: simple chordal texture with a clear melody on top.
video_use_ideas: Sketch material for a film-score cue: take the opening bars and re-orchestrate.
legal_notes: Composer died 1856 (PD). OCR draft: optical music recognition (Audiveris 5.11) of the public-domain scan IMSLP #277064 (Clara Schumann ed., Breitkopf & Härtel 1885), corrected against the page images by an AI model (see tools/omr REPORT). Bar count matches the scan, 0 wrong-length bars, model self-estimate rhythm ~99%, pitch ~97% (an independent spot check of a GPT-6.1 Sol piece found pitch ~85% against a claimed 98%, so treat pitch claims as optimistic). MAY CONTAIN WRONG NOTES. Slurs, pedal and most ornaments not encoded. Transcription released CC0. MusicXML: files/scores/schumann_op124_albumblaetter_20.musicxml. Fills complete-set gap: Schumann Albumblätter Op. 124.
